name: fhold
description: Use your personal fhold agent from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to your local fhold agent. Requests pass through fhold's protected access layer, which applies the permissions you choose for this connection and screens untrusted input.

guardian_url.title: Local fhold address
guardian_url.description: Keep the default unless fhold shows a different address under Apps.

credential_key.title: fhold access key
credential_key.description: In fhold Admin, open Apps → Claude → Desktop chat, choose what Claude can do and select Create connection. Then select Copy access key in the connection instructions and paste it here. For an existing connection, edit permissions under Apps → Advanced access → Manage instead of creating another connection.
